thesis: COLM is in a clean uptrend with earnings recovery behind it: Sep-26 net income rose 63% YoY, free cash flow is positive and dilution risk is low. The post-earnings gap has held with higher lows. In a risk-off tape, consumer discretionary (XLY) is one of the few leading sectors and COLM shows strong relative strength. The setup is a pullback entry, not a chase, because RSI 71 and the extension above SMA20 argue against buying at the last price. A dip into the entry zone gives a defined stop and about 2:1 reward/risk toward the 52-week-high area. This is a moderate-conviction setup. The regime, valuation and short-term overextension cap the upside probability.
